scope: Lysates were acidified with 12 μl of 12% (v/v) phosphoric acid. Acidified lysates were then centrifuged at 12000xg for 5 min and the supernatant was collected into a clean tube prior to proteolytic digestions using suspension trapping (S-Trap).

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The experiment analyzed two distinct materials: IVD tissue and plasma. For the tissue, the protocol describes creating lysates from tissue sections followed by S-Trap digestion, which corresponds to a whole cell/tissue lysate scope. For the plasma, immunodepletion of abundant proteins was performed, but this is a standard cleanup for biofluids rather than affinity-purification of a specific protein complex.
